description: Quarterly Council audit Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G5 + G7 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_silen_review` and counter-signed by Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain. Includes const-field structural enforcement of the most critical gates: spreadProfitMkoto const 0 (G5), commercialRemittanceSoftwarePenetrationPct const 0 (G7), nonAdherentParticipationCount const 0 (G3). Any nonzero value in these const fields = critical finding, halts pool operations, triggers chigiri.disputeMediation + Council Lv7+ escalation.

totalVolumeUsdEquivalentMinor.description: Sum of all flows during the review period, normalized to USD-equivalent minor units at locked depositAttestation.fxRateBps per flow.

perCcyVolume.description: Per-currency breakdown of volume (aggregate; no per-member amounts).

matchedSharePctIntegerHundredths.description: Fraction of flows settled via counter-intent match (vs reserve buffer). Target ≥80.00% (= 8000) at R2+. R1 may be lower while pool flow is thin.

avgMatchWaitSeconds.description: Mean wait between depositAttestation and matchExecution across the period.

outOfBandHaltCount.description: Number of times fx_oracle_watcher cell halted matching due to withinBand=false. Target = 0. >0 = critical finding.

spreadProfitMkoto.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Any nonzero value invalidates this report at schema layer and indicates a constitutional violation (mid-market only invariant breached).

commercialRemittanceSoftwarePenetrationP.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Build-time lint at `70-tools/scripts/lint/verify_no_commercial_remittance.py` must show 0 imports of Wise / Western Union / MoneyGram / Remitly / WorldRemit / Xoom / Revolut / OFX / Currencies Direct / Ria / Paysend / Atlantic Money / Sendwave / Boss Revolution / PayPal-Xoom in the kawase-yui codebase.

nonAdherentParticipationCount.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Solidity `onlyAdherent` modifier on KawaseYuiPool.deposit + KawaseYuiPool.claim enforces this at the L6 chain layer; any nonzero count here = indexer bug (cell-level G3 violation impossible because the contract reverts).

jurisdictionsActivated.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 codes of jurisdictions active during the review period (i.e., had at least one valid jurisdictionAttestation per ADR-2605282200 G14).

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of Council members who attested this review. R1+ ≥3 (Lv6+ ≥3 threshold).
